events.title: Claude Code weekly limit +50%
events.quote: Claude Code weekly limits are increasing 50%, now through July 13. Live now for all Pro, Max, Team, and seat-based Enterprise users.
events.note: Reported verbatim from the official @ClaudeDevs post (May 13, 2026). Temporary lift on the WEEKLY cap only; paid plans (Pro/Max/Team/seat-based Enterprise), not Free or API/usage-based. Expires Jul 13, 6PM PDT unless extended. Stacks on the permanent 5-hour 2x.

events.title: Claude Code 5-hour limit doubled
events.quote: Anthropic announced it was doubling Claude Code five-hour rate limits for Pro, Max, Team, and seat-based Enterprise plans and removing peak-hours limit reduction for Claude Code on Pro and Max.
events.note: Permanent (no expiry announced). Doubles the rolling 5-hour cap and removed peak-hour throttling for Pro/Max on Claude Code. The temporary weekly +50% (separate event) stacks on top through Jul 13.

usage_reports.note: Single continuous session from 0% at window start. 385 Opus turns over ~1h02m reached 75% of the 5h cap (in-app indicator; may lag a few min). Session token usage: 283,476 output + 36,742 fresh input + 3,341,442 cache-write + 50,597,493 cache-read tokens. Priced at the Opus 4.8 API rate (input $5, output $25, 5-min cache-write $6.25, cache-read $0.50 per 1M), that is ~$53 of API-equivalent value for 75% of the window, implying ~$71 of API-equivalent Opus usage per full 5h window on a $20/mo Pro plan. (API-equivalent is a value comparison; the actual cap mechanic is not published.)
usage_reports.api_equiv_basis: Opus 4.8 API rate: input $5, output $25, 5-min cache-write $6.25, cache-read $0.50 per 1M tokens. Value comparison, not the cap mechanic.
usage_reports.evidence: Claude Code session transcript + in-app 5h usage indicator

usage_reports.note: Personal Pro account, weekly cap at 78% (in-app indicator). MEASURED FLOOR from local Claude Code transcripts (~/.claude/projects/**/*.jsonl), deduped by message.id, for the active weekly window (reset Wed 2026-06-03 17:00 EDT). SCOPED to personal projects only (path match 'personal'), because this machine also ran a SEPARATE work Pro login this week whose Claude Code burn hits a different account's cap. Attribution is a weak proxy: Claude Code's login is global per instance, not per project, so a personal-project session could have run on the work login (or vice-versa); transcripts record no account identity. Also excludes claude.ai web/desktop chat, which counts against this same cap. So the figure is a soft lower bound. 1,627 assistant turns: Opus 4.8 ($117), Sonnet 4.6 ($35), Haiku 4.5 ($0.41). At Anthropic API list rates that is ~$153 of API-equivalent value at 78%, implying a full weekly Claude Code budget of >=~$197 API-equivalent on a $20/mo Pro plan. (API-equivalent is a value comparison; the cap mechanic is not published.)
usage_reports.api_equiv_basis: Anthropic API list price per model (Opus 4.8 in $5 / out $25 / cw-5m $6.25 / cw-1h $10 / cr $0.50; Sonnet 4.6 $3/$15/$3.75/$6/$0.30; Haiku 4.5 $1/$5/$1.25/$2/$0.10 per 1M). See scripts/cc-usage.mjs. Value comparison, not the cap mechanic.
usage_reports.evidence: Aggregated ~/.claude/projects/**/*.jsonl assistant-turn usage via scripts/cc-usage.mjs --since 2026-06-03T21:00:00Z --match personal, deduped by message.id. Paired with in-app weekly % indicator. Scoped to personal projects as a weak account proxy (see note).

usage_reports.note: SEPARATE work Pro account (also $20/mo), read off the in-app Plan-usage panel: weekly 'all models' 79%, resets in ~1 day (exact reset time not shown). Same panel showed the 5-hour limit at 7% (resets ~4h) and a usage-credits pool at $0.00 of $40.00. Recorded as an OBSERVED-ONLY receipt: no measured-burn pairing, because (1) this machine ran two Claude logins this week and transcripts carry no account identity, and (2) the work weekly window's reset time is unknown, so per-account burn can't be scoped to the right window. The observed % is a real reading; any $ figure would be a guess on a guess.
usage_reports.evidence: In-app Claude Code Plan-usage panel screenshot (work account): 5-hour 7% resets 4h; Weekly all models 79% resets 1d; usage credits $0.00 of $40.00; context 82.5k/1.0M.

snapshots.note: Partial historical backfill from the Wayback Machine. `covers` lists the only providers this snapshot records, so the changelog diff is scoped to them (it will NOT report every other provider as 'added'). Every value below is taken verbatim from a dated archive capture; unverifiable values are left unpublished rather than guessed.

limits.quote: If your conversations are relatively short (approximately 200 English sentences, assuming your sentences are around 15-20 words), you can expect to send around 45 messages every 5 hours, often more depending on Claude's current capacity.

entries.quote: At least five times the usage per session compared to our free service.
entries.notes: Anthropic publishes a token budget, not a message count. The ~45 msg/5h figure is an official estimate from the now-retired 'About Claude's Pro Plan Usage' article (id 8324991, live URL now 404); cited here via the 2025-07-28 Wayback snapshot and tagged basis=estimate. It predates the 2026-05-06 Claude Code 5-hour doubling and may be stale for current chat. Pro is the 1x baseline for the Max 5x/20x multipliers. Price $20/mo ($17/mo annual) per claude.com/pricing.

measured.notes: Realized consumption for one billing month, not a cap. The API pool ran ~$33 against a stated 'at least $20' floor: gpt-5.5-medium used 42.8% of the pool for 30M tokens; at the Pro+-validated rate of ~$0.47/M that is ~$13.9, implying a ~$33 pool. Other API-pool models aren't individually itemized on the Pro screenshot, so only the observed gpt-5.5-medium rate is listed; see Pro+ for the full per-model rate card (rates are model-intrinsic API prices, shared across plans). Auto+Composer hit 100% and overflowed 16.9M tokens into the API pool. ~95% of all tokens are subsidized Auto.

entries.quote: $70 of API agent usage
entries.notes: Plus a non-numeric 'generous Auto and Composer usage' pool. On-demand usage billed in arrears after the included amount.

measured.source: Cursor dashboard, account-owner screenshots (2 billing months)
measured.notes: Derived $/M token = (pct/100 x $70 pool) / tokens. gpt-5.5-medium cross-validates at $0.46-0.49/M across two months (~5% agreement), confirming the method. Realized total varies 276M-841M tokens/mo by activity (not a cap). Anomaly excluded: claude-4.6-opus-high-thinking showed 8.3M tokens at 0.0% (likely promo/unbilled).
